name: Elecrow CrowPanel 5.79" E-Paper
description: Elecrow CrowPanel ESP32-S3 5.79 inch black/white e-paper HMI display (792x272, two cascaded SSD1683 controllers). Runs the native Tesserae device firmware (env `elecrow-crowpanel-579`) over the v1 REST device API and paints a raw 1-bpp mono buffer (26928 bytes) produced by the esp32_bw_bin renderer. The rotary switch moves through the rotation and its press re-renders; microSD slot supported; no battery sense on this board.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Wire format is exactly 26928 bytes (792*272/8), MSB=leftmost pixel, bit-set=white, bit-clear=black; no header, no padding, no checksum. The two controllers each drive 396 columns and leave an 8-column seam in their shared RAM; the firmware inserts it, so the frame carries only visible pixels. Default device ids look like CrowPanel_579_<mac-suffix>.
